title: Late EVD provenance overstates evidence-copy Ruff errors
rationale: The later EVD amendment says copying evidence sources as .py added 16 evidence-path Ruff errors. Retained private ruff-with-evidence.log lists exactly 10 I001 errors under specs/evidence/bug036-cache-20261101, plus six BUG037 E501 errors and one travel-script E501, for 17 total. ruff-final.log retains those same seven external errors after the evidence copies became inert .py.txt. The recorded run therefore supports 10 added evidence errors, not 16. This amendment is outside the original 16-document manifest hashes and was caught in the final exit-time inspection; it does not establish a code defect.
suggestion: Record 10 evidence-copy I001 errors / 17 total including seven external errors, cite the retained run, and refresh the document snapshot. If 16 refers to a different run, retain and identify that exact log instead. Reconcile EVD/TP-C08 and any exported preliminary report with this final document-only finding before claiming final joint-review closure.
